description:
Park Shin, a boy with the eyes that can see peoples fates, was abandoned by his father who never wanted a child, by his mother who predicted his grandmother's death (seeing it as a curse). He is told that there is such a girl who can remove the curse from his family... Shin decides to use his ability to run a taro cafe when he finally meets Sua Kim, the girl from his myth who can save him.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/55034399), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B5%AC%EC%9B%90%ED%95%B4%EC%A3%BC%EC%86%8C%EC%84%9C/4439), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/save_me_)
